content_sections.heading: Prabuddha Bharati Shishutirtha Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Prabuddha Bharati Shishutirtha for filling up various support staff positions in Paschim Medinipur, West Bengal.

faq.question: Q2. What positions are available in this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: The recruitment offers openings for Multipurpose Staff and Security Guard/ Night Guard posts, totaling 3 vacancies under advertisement number PBST /SS(KGP-2) /872/2026-27.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form is 19-10-2026. Candidates must ensure that their applications reach the designated address well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for Prabuddha Bharati Shishutirtha Recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is strictly offline. Interested candidates need to download the form, fill it out, attach required documents, and send it by post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC candidates is Nil. There is no fee required for any category to apply for these positions.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are needed for the Multipurpose Staff post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Multipurpose Staff position should be literate and possess knowledge and experience of working in the relevant working domain.

faq.question: Q7. What is the experience requirement for Security Guard positions?
faq.answer: Applicants for the Security Guard/ Night Guard position must have at least 2 years of experience working as security personnel, preferably being retired military or paramilitary personnel.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 8,000 to Rs. 12,000 per month depending on the post. Multipurpose Staff receive Rs. 12,000/- while Security Guards receive Rs. 8,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the candidates applying through this recruitment notification primarily consists of Document Verification based on eligibility and qualifications.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification PDF by visiting the Important Links section in this article and clicking the designated direct download link provided there.
